dialogues.speaker: Ipora
dialogues.text: This temperature is still the best...

dialogues.speaker: Ipora
dialogues.text: Hah, what are you talking about? I wouldn't be here if I was afraid of the heat!

dialogues.speaker: Ipora
dialogues.text: See those Koholasaurs? They should give you an idea of how hot these pools are.

dialogues.speaker: Ipora
dialogues.text: But really, I think it's great that you can soak in the pool and socialize with Koholasaurs while you're at it.

dialogues.speaker: Ipora
dialogues.text: Oh, and this guy from Inazuma taught me how to make hot spring eggs. So now, I've even got some snacks.

dialogues.speaker: Ipora
dialogues.text: Bye-bye! Be careful not to get scalded by the hot water!

dialogues.speaker: Ipora
dialogues.text: Got it. I'll soak for a while longer then head back.

dialogues.speaker: Ipora
dialogues.text: Phew... This almost feels like I'm melting from the inside out.
